description: How to self-exclude from gambling in a country: the national scheme (e.g. GAMSTOP in the UK, OASIS in Germany, RGIAJ in Spain, ANJ in France, Brazil's federal platform), what it covers, its terms, and the sign-up link. Use when someone wants to stop themselves gambling with licensed operators or close their betting accounts.
